Zara P: Heads-up from platform: we'll start honoring a canonical routing header next week: X-RW-POLICY (values `latency` | `cost`). Also asking SDKs to add a tiny quota attribution header X-Q-ATTR for console mapping. Please normalize casing and accept legacy keys (`route_hint`, `routeHint`) as fallbacks. cc @Ethan M @Noor K

Ethan M: Recommend SDKs not flip defaults for GA. Plan: expose explicit client option `SetRoutePolicy(...)` and env var `REDWOOD_ROUTE_MODE=off|opt-in|mirror`. Default = off for public releases.

Noor K: DevEx: agree on opt-in. We'll publish a helper that applies precedence: explicit param > X-RW-POLICY > legacy headers. Console ask: show an "Applied policy" column in sampled request viewer so teams can verify remaps.

Len (platform): Server-side compatibility: accept legacy variants for 90 days, default behavior unchanged. We'll emit a sampled telemetry event `routing.legacy_seen` and `routing.header_conflict` when both headers present. We'll attach trace links to conflicts.

deploy-bot: routing-api compat canary scheduled -> 2026-03-30 02:00 UTC (https://deploys.redwood.internal/routing-api/compat-canary) :rocket:

Ethan M: For Go/TS I'll add a small shim behind a feature flag and include `REDWOOD_ROUTE_MODE`. We'll log when remap happens and increment `sdk.route_remap` telemetry counter with tags {lang,mode,remapped}. Default remains off.

Zara P: Add telemetry requirement: emit `sdk.route_conflict` sampled when both legacy+new present, and include a `sdk.route_remap` counter. Console needs a tile "Routing remaps (sampled)" linking to raw examples and the trace.

Noor K: Python helper for RFC:
```python
def set_route_headers(headers, policy=None):
    # precedence: explicit param > new header > legacy keys
    if policy:
        headers['X-RW-POLICY'] = policy
    else:
        for k in ('X-RW-POLICY','x-rw-policy','route_hint','routeHint'):
            if k in headers:
                headers['X-RW-POLICY'] = headers[k]
                break
    headers['X-Q-ATTR'] = headers.get('X-Q-ATTR', f"sdk:py:{__version__}")
```

Ethan M: Will include small migration note in CHANGELOG + README and a one-line snippet in release notes showing how to opt-in via env var. Also will add a test that asserts precedence ordering.

Len (platform): Confirmed: legacy acceptance window ends 2026-09-01. We'll publish a compatibility doc tomorrow and provide tenant-level sample rates for `routing.legacy_seen`.

Zara P: Agreement: ship SDK helpers behind feature flag, default off. For internal canary builds set `mirror` to preview. Quick sync tomorrow 10:30 PT in #devex to review telemetry dashboards and console tile mockups. Thanks! :thumbsup:
